title: Wasm Dynamic Exec
objective: Make Python compile/eval/exec execute synchronously in the production browser evaluator under CSP, including mpmath dynamic arithmetic and hypergeometric workflows, with Chromium regression coverage and packaged authenticated assets.

handoff.summary: Production browser evaluators now expose authoritative synchronous Python compile/eval/exec through an isolated compiler-worker RPC. Non-isolated hosts execute authenticated precompiled dynamic programs, including mpmath arithmetic and hyp2f1, and reject unknown source or namespace shapes clearly. The dynamic bundle is receipt-backed and production-packaged, and focused Chromium coverage exercises both hosting modes.
risks: Unrestricted dynamic execution requires SharedArrayBuffer/cross-origin isolation; non-isolated hosts intentionally support only authenticated precompiled programs.
The synchronous compiler response buffer is capped at 8 MiB and requests time out after 120 seconds.
The full architecture check is currently blocked by native export inventory drift already present in base 30336689; architecture:wasm passes.
next_steps: Rebuild the final integrated production artifact and run the complete portable/release browser matrix on the integration head.
Serve mobile WebViews from the authenticated loopback origin with COOP/COEP to enable unrestricted dynamic execution.
